title: Email from a landlord with an N4 notice attached
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Hard positive: the official form arrives as an email attachment described in prose. Synthetic.
summary_en: A landlord's email saying an N4 notice is attached: the tenant owes $2,300.00 and must pay by 25/09/2026 or move out, or the landlord will apply to the Landlord and Tenant Board.
text:
From: Property Manager <manager@fictional-parkside-rentals.example>
To: Tenant, Apt 12
Subject: N4 notice - 44 Parkside Drive Apt 12

Hi,

Please find attached Form N4 (Notice to End your Tenancy Early for Non-payment of Rent) for your unit. As of today the rent owing is $2,300.00 (August and September). The termination date on the notice is 25/09/2026. If the full amount is paid by that date the notice is void; otherwise we will file an L1 application with the Landlord and Tenant Board to end the tenancy and collect the rent owing.

A paper copy was also placed in your mailbox today.

Regards,
Parkside Rentals (fictional)
Attachment: N4_Apt12.pdf
